purpose: Paired design on full 5k, harness v1, same attacks as flagship reference. Test if multi-view averaging explains the robustness edge between ff and flagship.

design.surface: full 5k validation set (same indices as flagship reference)

per_ff_seed_metrics.delta_mv_wc: WC(multi-view ff) - WC(single-view ff) on same images
per_ff_seed_metrics.delta_mv_clean: clean(multi-view ff) - clean(single-view ff) on same images

reference_edge.description: flagship seed 42 (37.72) - mean ff (35.79) = 1.93 pp on 5k

thresholds_chosen.name: explains_threshold_pp
thresholds_chosen.rationale: Mean delta_mv >= 1.0 pp required to explain

thresholds_chosen.name: no_effect_threshold_pp
thresholds_chosen.rationale: Mean delta_mv <= 0.3 pp reported as inconclusive for explanation (ff never trained on shifted views)

readings.EXPLAINS: mean delta_mv >= 1.0 pp AND the paired bootstrap 95% CI (resampling images) excludes 0
readings.NO-EFFECT-SEEN: mean delta_mv <= 0.3 pp (reported as inconclusive for the explanation, because ff was never trained on shifted views)

required_sanity_checks: APGD-CE vs APGD-T agreement on a 1k subset
notes: v1.1 rejected (vacuous threshold on 1k; single-view ff already cleared bar). This is paired on 5k.
